description: Checks a public GitHub repo: every package its lockfiles pin at its latest commit, in every folder and 14 ecosystems (npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go, Maven, NuGet, RubyGems, Packagist, Pub, Swift, Hex, Hackage, CRAN, Julia), against every known flaw. Says the answer on the site's scale (yes, mostly, kind-of, no; unknown when it holds no lockfile we can read), what to update first and what each flaw lets someone do, in plain words. A first look at a big repo takes a few seconds.

full.description: Also every flaw of every package (hundreds of KB for a big repo). Without it: the answer, what to update and why, and where the full list is.

repo.description: owner/name, or the repo's GitHub URL: vercel/next.js, https://github.com/pallets/flask
